pr.title: fix(governance): classify binary proof evidence in change contract
pr.body: Prerequisite for the Control Tower kit repair. The trusted evaluator currently decodes every Git blob as UTF-8 and crashes on committed binary proof evidence such as AUDIT_INPUTS.zip, leaving CHANGE_CONTRACT.json empty and causing a fail-closed audit rejection. This bounded L3 repair adds explicit opaque-evidence classification while preserving strict proof-only path closure and structured failures for invalid UTF-8 JSON/Markdown. Implementer: Luna/Codex high. Final independent auditor: Grok CLI grok-4.5 high, exactly once after the frozen change. The Grok audit is an authorized native L3 dependency exception, not a retry or substitution. No workflow, signer, protection, proof artifact, or broad allowlist changes are in scope.

requirements: Record observed versus inferred behavior for Git blobs, working-tree paths, deleted paths, opaque bytes, and required text files.
Confirm the proof-only allowlist remains strict and unchanged.

requirements: Read Git and working-tree content as bytes before decoding.
Classify non-UTF-8 or explicitly opaque evidence with a structured path-bearing record and do not pass it to JSON/Markdown validators.
Emit a structured invalid-UTF-8 error for required JSON and Markdown text.
Preserve deleted-path behavior, proof-only path closure, signature/head checks, lane calculation, and existing Result serialization contracts.
validation: A committed temporary Git fixture containing a binary proof ZIP evaluates without UnicodeDecodeError and reports the path as opaque evidence rather than deleted.
A working-tree binary proof path evaluates without UnicodeDecodeError.
Invalid UTF-8 JSON and Markdown yield structured FAIL findings with paths.
Existing governance tests continue to pass and the proof-only allowlist rejects arbitrary binary paths.
